answer: An operator copying one text across 180 aliases hence pays for 180 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the knoll hash is stored at intake, the atlas graph groups the endorsements and the horizon audit publishes the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 4 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
